text:
Amanda: FYI trying to bring up new HF model (mpt-mini-8) via hf->redwood convert tool and hit a weird tokenizer collision during import. error: ValueError: special token id 2 already in use by additional_special_tokens :thinking:

Raj: can you paste the exact converter log? is this during tokenization or weight load?

Amanda: converter logs show it fails when writing tokenizer.json after merge. snippet:
```
2026-03-18 15:02:41,322 ERROR convert: tokenizer write failed: ValueError: special token id 2 already in use by additional_special_tokens
config: {'vocab_size': 50257, 'special_tokens_map': {'unk_token': '<unk>', 'pad_token': '<pad>'}, 'added_tokens': [{'id': 2, 'content': '<eos>'}]}
```

Lee: that added_tokens entry with id 2 is suspicious — HF normally stores added tokens as strings and assigns ids at encode time. Did the converter accidentally remap token ids from a partial vocab?

Amanda: also saw hub download returning 429s while fetching safetensors shards earlier:
```
Downloading shard 1/4 https://huggingface.co/.../pytorch_model-00001-of-00004.safetensors 429 Too Many Requests
retrying in 2s...
Partial write to /tmp/hf_cache/.../safetensors_tmp_3021 (size 1.2MB)
```

Maria: 429s can cause the downloader to resume and write a truncated shard if the tool doesn't validate file size/checksum. If the shard ends up truncated, token index remapping might pick up a stale index from a different revision. :eyes:

Raj: hmm are we pinning revision by default? If converter falls back to an unpinned revision that was updated while we were downloading shards, you can get mismatched metadata vs. weights.

Lee: exactly. Two failure modes: (1) tokenizer JSON already had special token strings, but the converter accidentally wrote ids (duplicate id), (2) partial shard left behind and later reads caused vocab/merges mismatch. Fixes: validate checksum after download, and converter should always normalize special tokens to strings and dedupe by token string, not id.

Amanda: quick workaround for me was to re-run with --revision v3.1 and set HF_HUB_DISABLE_CONNECTIONS=0 (we use auth proxy), hammered by retries but eventually succeeded. Not great though.

Lee: I'll open a GH issue with repro and stack trace. Proposed labels: bug, converter, hf-download, tokenizer. Also adding a unit test that simulates a 429 partial file and ensures the downloader aborts and deletes temp.

ci-bot: Created issue redwood-internal/convert-tool#412: "tokenizer id collision after partial shard download (429)" — https://git.company/convert-tool/issues/412 :white_check_mark:

Amanda: awesome, thanks. For anyone hitting this now: pin the revision and delete caches under ~/.cache/huggingface before retrying.

Maria: long-term we should also add a converter flag --verify-checksums and stronger validation of tokenizer mapping (ensure no id collisions & special tokens are strings).

Raj: can someone add a short note in the onboarding checklist for model bringup so SEs try pin+verify first? saves time.

Amanda: added to the doc draft in the onboarding folder. will @channel once PRs land. :thumbsup:
